paper_title: Constraining the photon coupling of ultra-light dark-matter axion-like particles by polarization variations of parsec-scale jets in active galaxies
notes: Constraint on axion-photon coupling from periodic EVPA (polarization angle) oscillations of parsec-scale AGN jets in MOJAVE VLBA data. 95% CL limit ~10^-12 GeV^-1 for m between 5e-23 and 1.2e-21 eV (Fig 6, kappa=1). Limit scales as gaγ ∝ m (from Eq 2.2), so weakens toward higher mass; data points approximate the Figure 6 curve.
